card.name: Subject just before outcome verb
card.fires_on: The end of a subject noun or the start of a split verb, where a past-tense verb about what a group experienced or how it fared comes next. Seen in general web text, not drug labels.

card.writes: It favors verbs of experience or outcome like experienced, felt, faced and found, and disfavors causal verbs like allowed, affected and enabled.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to say what happened to or how a group fared.
